comment.cs: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Různé</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Pozměňovací návrhy 5 a 7 byly zrušeny z technických důvodů.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Aon ghnó eile</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Tá na leasuithe 5 agus 7 curtha ar ceal ar chúiseanna teicniúla.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Miscellaneous</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendments 5 and 7 had been cancelled for technical reasons.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentele 5 și 7 au fost anulate din motive tehnice.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diversos</title><remarkFreeText><translation>As alterações 5 e 7 são anuladas por motivos técnicos.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Divers</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Les amendements 5 et 7 sont annulés pour des raisons techniques.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Dažādi</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Grozījumi Nr. 5 un Nr. 7 ir atcelti tehnisku iemeslu dēļ.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Varios</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Las enmiendas 5 y 7 han sido anuladas por razones técnicas.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Varie</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Gli emendamenti 5 e 7 sono annullati per motivi tecnici.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.da: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ændringsforslag 5 og 7 var blevet annulleret af tekniske årsager.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lt: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Įvairūs</title><remarkFreeText><translation>5 ir 7 pakeitimai buvo panaikinti dėl techninių priežasčių.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Predloga sprememb 5 in 7 sta iz tehničnih razlogov razveljavljena.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.de: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Verschiedenes</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Die Änderungsanträge 5 und 7 werden aus technischen Gründen annulliert.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sv: <remarkFreeTexts order="2"><title>Övriga frågor</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ändringsförslagen 5 och 7 hade annullerats av tekniska orsaker.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
